kernel: arccos degree-1 (NNGP), composed L times, unit sphere
policy_rule: Among panel policies whose counted propagation cost is <= `cost_ceiling`, choose the one with the smallest MMD^2. Ties (relative difference < 1e-12) break toward the SMALLER k, because a smaller k is cheaper and the tie says the objective cannot separate them. If no policy fits the ceiling, the rule REFUSES rather than returning the cheapest.
design_falsifier: The proxy is DISCARDED, not re-tuned, if the DESIGN ranking of the panel by paired adjusted score does not agree with the MMD^2 ranking in its top-3 ordering (Spearman over the panel <= 0). GAME_PLAN section 7: 'carrier proxy does not predict DESIGN ranking -> discard the proxy; do not optimize it harder.'
proposed_score_gate: A carrier policy is promotable only if the paired ARITHMETIC adjusted-score difference against exact v2.7, with a studentised-t or basic-bootstrap 95% interval excluding zero, shows >= 2x improvement on a fresh DESIGN block, replicated on a disjoint DESIGN block. Percentile bootstrap and BCa are refused. Every MSE carries its ground-truth noise floor.
limitation: An infinite-width NNGP kernel cannot certify finite-width, network-specific ranking. A good MMD^2 is NECESSARY, NOT SUFFICIENT. This panel selects nothing; a DESIGN block does.
